## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped to one concern and leaves unrelated behavior untouched.
- [ ] Existing framework features, project patterns, and shared components are reused where they fit.
- [ ] The implementation is as simple as the behavior allows and lives at the appropriate layer.
- [ ] Queries, external calls, and rendering avoid unnecessary repeated work.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior, or the verification section explains why no test applies.
- [ ] Relevant formatting, static analysis, type, build, and test checks pass.
- [ ] Comments explain only non-obvious constraints rather than narrating the code.
- [ ] Visual changes include screenshots or concrete before-and-after evidence; otherwise this is not applicable.
